project.name: Fast DDS
project.description: eProsima Fast DDS is a C++ implementation of the DDS (Data Distribution Service) standard by the OMG (Object Management Group), providing publisher-subscriber communications over unreliable transports such as UDP via the RTPS protocol.

nodes.name: pegtl.hpp
nodes.summary: Main umbrella header for the taocpp PEGTL (Parsing Expression Grammar Template Library) that aggregates all core headers including parsing rules, input adapters, and action/state changers.

nodes.name: analyze_cycles.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements cycle detection in PEG grammar rule graphs to identify rules that can loop without consuming input, preventing infinite recursion during parsing.

nodes.name: counted.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides counted analysis helper that wraps generic analysis with a count of sub-rules, used for grammar introspection.

nodes.name: generic.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the generic analysis template that recursively inserts grammar rules into a grammar_info structure for static analysis.

nodes.name: grammar_info.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the grammar_info data structure that maps demangled rule names to their rule_info metadata for grammar analysis.

nodes.name: insert_guard.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides an RAII insert_guard that inserts elements into a container on construction and erases them on destruction, used for cycle detection stack management.

nodes.name: rule_info.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the rule_info struct that stores a rule's type classification and its list of sub-rule names for grammar analysis.

nodes.name: rule_type.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the rule_type enumeration classifying PEG rules as seq (sequence), sor (ordered choice), opt (optional), or any (any-of).

nodes.name: analyze.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the top-level analyze() function template that invokes cycle analysis on a PEG grammar and returns the count of detected problems.

nodes.name: apply_mode.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the apply_mode enumeration (action and nothing) controlling whether user actions are invoked during parsing.

nodes.name: argv_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides argv_input, a convenience input adapter that creates a PEGTL input from command-line argument strings with source tracking.

nodes.name: ascii.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines ASCII character matching rules including ranges, classes (alpha, digit, alnum, etc.), and EOL-aware character predicates for PEG grammars.

nodes.name: buffer_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements buffer_input, a buffered input adapter for the PEGTL that manages a dynamically sized read buffer with chunked reading, position tracking, and marker support.

nodes.name: change_action.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_action wrapper that substitutes a different action class when matching a sub-rule in a PEG grammar.

nodes.name: change_action_and_state.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_action_and_state wrapper that replaces both the action class and state when matching a sub-rule, with success forwarding to the original action.

nodes.name: change_action_and_states.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_action_and_states wrapper that replaces the action class and uses a tuple of multiple states when matching a sub-rule, leveraging index sequences.

nodes.name: change_control.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_control wrapper that substitutes a different control class when matching a sub-rule, enabling custom parse error handling.

nodes.name: change_state.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_state wrapper that substitutes a different state object when matching a sub-rule, with success forwarding to the original state.

nodes.name: change_states.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the change_states wrapper that replaces the state with a tuple of multiple state objects when matching a sub-rule, using index sequences for tuple unpacking.

nodes.name: config.hpp
nodes.summary: Core configuration header that defines the TAO_PEGTL_NAMESPACE macro used throughout the library for namespace customization and backwards compatibility.

nodes.name: abnf.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PEG rules for ABNF (Augmented Backus-Naur Form) core rules per RFC 5234, including ALPHA, DIGIT, VCHAR, WSP, CRLF, and other terminal classes.

nodes.name: alphabet.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines template-based alphabet character classes (a-z, A-Z, hex digits) using compile-time arrays for PEG rule matching.

nodes.name: changes.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides helper templates (change_action_and_state, change_action_and_states) for conveniently combining multiple action/state/control changes in contrib grammars.

nodes.name: counter.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides a debug control class that counts and reports rule match start/success/failure events with demangled rule names for PEG grammar debugging.

nodes.name: http.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines a complete HTTP 1.1 grammar per RFC 7230 as PEG rules, including request/response parsing, header fields, chunked transfer encoding, and a chunk helper action class.

nodes.name: internal.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides ICU-integrated PEG rule templates (property and category) that use Unicode ICU library functions for property-based and category-based character matching.

nodes.name: utf16.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines a comprehensive set of ICU-based Unicode property and category rules for UTF-16 encoded input, covering general categories, scripts, and binary properties.

nodes.name: utf32.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines a comprehensive set of ICU-based Unicode property and category rules for UTF-32 encoded input, mirroring the UTF-16 rules for the UTF-32 encoding.

nodes.name: utf8.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines ICU-based Unicode property and category rules for UTF-8 encoded input, providing Unicode character matching using ICU library functions.

nodes.name: if_then.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides if_then and if_then_else PEG rules that implement conditional matching: match a condition, then match one of two branches based on success or failure.

nodes.name: integer.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides integer parsing and conversion utilities for PEGTL grammars, handling positive/negative integer conversion with overflow detection.

nodes.name: json.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PEG grammar rules for parsing JSON data, including strings, numbers, arrays, objects, and values.

nodes.name: json_pointer.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PEG grammar rules for parsing JSON Pointer references (RFC 6901).

nodes.name: parse_tree.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides parse tree building infrastructure for PEGTL, enabling construction of AST nodes during parsing with configurable node selection and transformation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses heavy template metaprogramming with variadic templates, SFINAE, and CRTP patterns for compile-time rule selection.

nodes.name: parse_tree_to_dot.hpp
nodes.summary: Generates DOT (Graphviz) output from PEGTL parse trees for visualization and debugging.

nodes.name: raw_string.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements raw string literal parsing rules for PEGTL, supporting customizable delimiters and escape handling.

nodes.name: remove_first_state.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that removes the first state from the state stack during parsing actions.

nodes.name: remove_last_states.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that removes the last N states from the state stack during parsing actions.

nodes.name: rep_one_min_max.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements repetition rule with configurable minimum and maximum bounds for single-character matching.

nodes.name: rep_string.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements string repetition rule for matching repeated string patterns in PEGTL grammars.

nodes.name: shuffle_states.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that reorders state stack elements using a configurable shuffle permutation during parsing.

nodes.name: to_string.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides string conversion utilities for PEGTL types using a customizable to_string trait.

nodes.name: tracer.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements parse tracing control for PEGTL, providing detailed debug output of rule matching, success, and failure events.

nodes.name: unescape.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides string unescaping utilities for PEGTL, handling UTF-8 encoding, hex sequences, and standard escape characters.

nodes.name: uri.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PEG grammar rules for parsing URI/IRI references according to RFC 3986.

nodes.name: cstream_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides input adapter for C-style FILE streams, enabling PEGTL parsing from C FILE pointers.

nodes.name: disable_action.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that disables action dispatching during rule matching, delegating to match with apply_mode::nothing.

nodes.name: discard_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that discards consumed input after successful rule matching.

nodes.name: discard_input_on_failure.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that discards consumed input only when rule matching fails.

nodes.name: discard_input_on_success.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that discards consumed input only when rule matching succeeds.

nodes.name: enable_action.hpp
nodes.summary: Control wrapper that enables action dispatching during rule matching, delegating to match with apply_mode::action.

nodes.name: eol.hpp
nodes.summary: Configures end-of-line handling for PEGTL, selecting between CR, LF, CRLF, and mixed EOL modes.

nodes.name: eol_pair.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the EOL pair type used for end-of-line detection in PEGTL inputs.

nodes.name: file_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides file-based input source for PEGTL, using memory-mapped or buffered file reading.

nodes.name: input_error.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines input error exception type for PEGTL, wrapping system-level I/O errors.

nodes.name: action.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the internal action dispatch mechanism for PEGTL, invoking user-defined actions on successful rule matches.

nodes.name: action_input.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides action-aware input wrapper that tracks position and enables character peeking during action dispatch.

nodes.name: alnum.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the alphanumeric character rule for PEGTL, matching [a-zA-Z0-9] characters.

nodes.name: alpha.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the alphabetic character rule for PEGTL, matching [a-zA-Z] characters.

nodes.name: always_false.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines a type trait that always evaluates to false, used for static_assert dependent false conditions in templates.

nodes.name: any.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'any' rule that matches a single byte from input using a Peek functor, with support for tracking line endings via bump operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CRTP-style template specialization with Peek functor to match any single character from input.

nodes.name: apply.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'apply' rule that invokes a sequence of action functors on matched input data, using variadic template recursion to dispatch each action.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses variadic template recursion pattern (apply_impl) to chain multiple action applications sequentially.

nodes.name: apply0.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'apply0' rule that invokes action functors without passing matched input data, using variadic template recursion.
nodes.languageNotes: Variants of apply.hpp that calls apply0 instead of apply on each action, omitting the input parameter.

nodes.name: apply0_single.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'apply0_single' rule that invokes a single action functor's apply0 method, with SFINAE dispatch based on whether the action accepts an empty apply0 signature.

nodes.name: apply_single.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'apply_single' rule that invokes a single action functor's apply method with matched input data, using SFINAE to detect the correct overload.

nodes.name: at.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'at' rule for positive lookahead assertions that verify a pattern matches without consuming input, using rewind_mode::required.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rewind_mode::required to ensure the input position is restored after the lookahead test.

nodes.name: bof.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'bof' (beginning of file) rule that matches only when the input position is at byte 0, i.e., the very start of input.

nodes.name: bol.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'bol' (beginning of line) rule that matches only when the input position is at byte_in_line 0, i.e., the start of a line.

nodes.name: bump.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the bump helper function that advances the input iterator by a specified count while tracking line number and byte-in-line position for end-of-line characters.

nodes.name: bump_help.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the bump_help template function that conditionally advances the input iterator, tracking line positions only for non-end-of-line characters when result_on_found is set to donothing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses template metaprogramming with bool_and to conditionally compile line-tracking logic based on whether the bumped character matches the EOL character.

nodes.name: bytes.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'bytes<N>' rule that matches exactly N bytes of input, using bump to advance the iterator and checking that sufficient input remains.

nodes.name: control.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'control' rule that wraps another rule's match with a custom Control class, allowing override of the control flow (start/success/failure) for a specific rule.

nodes.name: cr_crlf_eol.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL end-of-line rule for CR and CRLF line endings, detecting single CR and two-byte CRLF sequences using peek_char.

nodes.name: cr_eol.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL end-of-line rule for CR-only (\r) line endings, matching a single CR character and bumping to the next line.

nodes.name: crlf_eol.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL end-of-line rule for CRLF (\r\n) line endings, matching the two-byte sequence using peek_char.

nodes.name: cstream_reader.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements a PEGTL reader that reads input from a C FILE* stream using std::fread, with error handling for read failures and EOF detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses operator() to implement the reader interface, reading chunks from a FILE* stream with fread and checking feof for end-of-stream.

nodes.name: cstring_reader.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements a PEGTL reader that reads input from a C-style null-terminated string using std::strlen and std::memcpy into a buffer.

nodes.name: demangle.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the demangle function that converts C++ mangled type names to human-readable form, dispatching to cxxabi or nop implementations based on compiler support, with a fallback that strips common prefixes using string manipulation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses conditional compilation to select between cxxabi::__cxa_demangle (GCC/Clang) and a manual string-parsing fallback for MSVC and other compilers.

nodes.name: demangle_cxxabi.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the GCC/Clang-specific demangle function using abi::__cxa_demangle with RAII cleanup via unique_ptr, then sanitising the result.

nodes.name: demangle_nop.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides a no-op demangle fallback that returns the raw mangled type name unchanged, used when no demangling support is available.

nodes.name: demangle_sanitise.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides the demangle_sanitise_chars function that post-processes demangled type names by replacing compiler-specific substrings like 'std::__cxx11::' and 'std::__1::' with clean 'std::' prefixes.

nodes.name: disable.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'disable' rule wrapper that forces apply_mode::nothing when matching the contained rule, preventing any action callbacks from being invoked.

nodes.name: discard.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'discard' rule that consumes input bytes without producing any output, using the discard() method to advance the iterator.

nodes.name: dusel_mode.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the dusel_mode enum class with values 'nothing', 'action', and 'action0' that controls the matching dispatch mode in the duseltronik template engine.

nodes.name: duseltronik.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the core PEGTL matching engine with four duseltronik specializations handling different combinations of dusel_mode and rewind_mode, dispatching to Control::start/success/failure hooks and action application.
nodes.languageNotes: Four template specializations handle all combinations of dusel_mode (nothing/action/action0) and rewind_mode (required/active), forming the heart of the PEGTL matching dispatch.

nodes.name: enable.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'enable' rule wrapper that forces apply_mode::action when matching the contained rule, ensuring action callbacks are always invoked.

nodes.name: endian.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides host-to-big-endian, big-endian-to-host, host-to-little-endian, and little-endian-to-host byte-order conversion functions, dispatching to platform-specific implementations.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides both type-safe overloads (using memcpy to avoid aliasing violations) and direct integral overloads for endian conversion.

nodes.name: endian_gcc.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements GCC/Clang-specific byte-order conversion using __builtin_bswap16/32/64 intrinsics for fast endian swapping on 16, 32, and 64-bit values.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses __builtin_bswap intrinsic functions for direct byte-swapping and memcpy for type-safe conversions, with template specializations for 1, 2, 4, and 8-byte values.

nodes.name: endian_win.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements Windows/MSVC-specific byte-order conversion using _byteswap_ushort, _byteswap_ulong, and _byteswap_uint64 intrinsics.
nodes.languageNotes: Windows counterpart to endian_gcc.hpp, using MSVC _byteswap_* intrinsics instead of GCC __builtin_bswap*.

nodes.name: eof.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements the PEGTL 'eof' rule that matches only when the input is empty (at end-of-file), succeeding if input.empty() is true.

nodes.name: eol.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL template rule for matching end-of-line (EOL) sequences. Provides a configurable EOL matching rule that delegates to the input's eol_t type for platform-specific line ending detection.

nodes.name: eolf.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL template rule for matching end-of-line (EOL) or end-of-file (EOF). Extends EOL matching to also recognize EOF as a valid line terminator.

nodes.name: file_mapper_posix.hpp
nodes.summary: POSIX implementation of memory-mapped file I/O for PEGTL. Uses mmap/munmap system calls to efficiently map files into memory for parsing.

nodes.name: file_mapper_win32.hpp
nodes.summary: Windows (Win32) implementation of memory-mapped file I/O for PEGTL. Uses CreateFile2, CreateFileMappingW, and MapViewOfFile APIs for file mapping on Windows platforms.

nodes.name: file_opener.hpp
nodes.summary: POSIX file opener utility for PEGTL. Provides RAII-based file descriptor management using open/close system calls with error handling.

nodes.name: file_reader.hpp
nodes.summary: File reader utility for PEGTL that reads entire files into memory using C FILE* API. Provides size detection via fseek/ftell and sequential reading via fread.

nodes.name: has_apply.hpp
nodes.summary: SFINAE trait to detect whether an action class has a static apply method. Used by PEGTL's action dispatch mechanism to conditionally call apply.

nodes.name: has_apply0.hpp
nodes.summary: SFINAE trait to detect whether an action class has a static apply0 method (apply without state parameter). Used for zero-argument action dispatch.

nodes.name: has_match.hpp
nodes.summary: SFINAE trait to detect whether a rule class has a static match method. Essential for PEGTL's rule matching system to differentiate between simple and complex rules.

nodes.name: identifier.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching C-style identifiers. Combines peek_char, ranges, seq, and star rules to match alphanumeric identifiers starting with a letter or underscore.

nodes.name: if_apply.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule that conditionally applies actions after successful matching. Implements if_apply and if_apply_impl template classes for applying actions with state and iterator parameters.

nodes.name: if_missing.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL helper for handling missing optional elements. Provides apply and apply0 methods that use markers to track positions when optional matches fail.

nodes.name: if_must.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule implementing conditional must-match semantics. If a condition matches, subsequent rules must also match or a parse error is raised.

nodes.name: if_must_else.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule combining if_then_else with must semantics. Provides if_must_else template that enforces matching on both branches of a conditional.

nodes.name: if_then_else.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule implementing if-then-else conditional matching. Uses markers and rewind modes to try the 'then' branch first, falling back to 'else' if condition fails.

nodes.name: input_pair.hpp
nodes.summary: Simple pair utility for PEGTL input sources. Holds a pointer and size pair representing a contiguous memory region for parsing.

nodes.name: integer_sequence.hpp
nodes.summary: C++11 polyfill for std::integer_sequence. Provides make_integer_sequence and integer_sequence utilities for compile-time sequence generation used in template metaprogramming.

nodes.name: istream_reader.hpp
nodes.summary: Input stream reader for PEGTL. Wraps std::istream to provide a read function object that reads data into buffers with error handling.

nodes.name: istring.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for case-insensitive string matching. Implements istring template that compares characters case-insensitively using ichar_equal helper.

nodes.name: iterator.hpp
nodes.summary: Iterator wrapper for PEGTL input sources. Provides position tracking and reset functionality for parsing state management.

nodes.name: lf_crlf_eol.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching both LF and CRLF line endings. Handles the two most common line ending formats (Unix LF and Windows CRLF).

nodes.name: lf_eol.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching Unix-style LF line endings only. Simpler variant that only accepts '\n' as a line terminator.

nodes.name: list.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching comma-separated lists. Combines seq and star to match one or more items separated by a separator rule.

nodes.name: list_must.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching lists with mandatory separator matching. Like list but raises an error if a separator is found but the following item fails to match.

nodes.name: list_tail.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching lists with optional trailing separator. Extends list matching to optionally accept a trailing separator after the last item.

nodes.name: list_tail_pad.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching padded lists with optional trailing separator. Combines list, opt, pad, seq, and star for whitespace-tolerant list parsing.

nodes.name: marker.hpp
nodes.summary: Position marker for PEGTL parsing state. Tracks input positions and provides rewind functionality for backtracking in PEG parsers.

nodes.name: must.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule that converts match failures into parse errors. Wraps rules to raise an error via raise template if the inner rule fails to match.

nodes.name: not_at.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL negative lookahead rule. Matches successfully only if the inner rule does NOT match at the current position, without consuming input.

nodes.name: one.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rule for matching single characters from a set. Provides one template that matches if the current character is in the specified set of characters.

nodes.name: opt.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL optional combinator that matches a rule zero or one time, implementing the PEG '?' operator as a template struct with a static match method.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses C++ template specialization with SFINAE to implement PEG optional matching at compile time.

nodes.name: pad.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL padding combinator that wraps a rule with optional leading and trailing padding characters using seq, star, and opt combinators.

nodes.name: pad_opt.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL optional padding combinator combining pad and opt to make the entire padded match optional.

nodes.name: peek_char.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for single-byte characters that reads one byte from input without consuming it, returning a peek_char result type.

nodes.name: peek_mask_uint.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for masked multi-byte unsigned integers (16/32/64-bit) that reads bytes and applies a bitmask before returning.

nodes.name: peek_mask_uint8.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for masked single-byte unsigned integers that reads one byte and applies a bitmask.

nodes.name: peek_uint.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for multi-byte unsigned integers (16/32/64-bit) that reads raw bytes from input in host or big/little endian order.

nodes.name: peek_uint8.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for single unsigned byte that reads one byte from input without consuming it.

nodes.name: peek_utf16.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for UTF-16 encoded characters, handling both basic multilingual plane (2 bytes) and supplementary characters (4 bytes with surrogate pairs).
nodes.languageNotes: Implements surrogate pair decoding for supplementary Unicode characters in UTF-16.

nodes.name: peek_utf32.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL peek implementation for UTF-32 encoded characters that reads a 4-byte code point directly from input.

nodes.name: peek_utf8.hpp

nodes.languageNotes: Implements multi-byte UTF-8 decoding with continuation byte validation per RFC 3629.

nodes.name: pegtl_string.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL compile-time string literal utility providing the TAOCPP_PEGTL_STRING macro for creating PEG string rules from C++ string literals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses variadic template parameter packs and constexpr to convert string literals to template type lists at compile time.

nodes.name: plus.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL one-or-more combinator that matches a rule at least once, implementing the PEG '+' operator by combining seq and star.

nodes.name: raise.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL raise combinator that unconditionally triggers a parse error by calling Control::raise with a custom exception type.

nodes.name: range.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL character range combinator that matches a single character within a specified inclusive range (e.g., 'a' to 'z').

nodes.name: ranges.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL multiple character ranges combinator that matches a character against several inclusive ranges using variadic templates and recursive range_impl.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses recursive template instantiation with range_impl to check multiple character ranges at compile time.

nodes.name: read_uint.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL unsigned integer reader that provides endian-aware byte-to-integer conversion for 16, 32, and 64-bit values using big-endian and little-endian specializations.
nodes.languageNotes: Template specializations for each integer size and endianness, delegating to endian helpers.

nodes.name: rematch.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL rematch combinator that tries to match a head rule, then repeatedly matches tail rules on the same input portion by rewinding, enabling regex-like backtracking semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses memory_input rewinding to re-parse matched portions against subsequent rules.

nodes.name: rep.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL repeat-exactly-N combinator that matches a rule exactly N times using a compile-time counter and recursive match calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses integer_sequence-based unrolling for compile-time repetition count.

nodes.name: rep_min.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL repeat-minimum combinator that matches a rule at least Min times by combining rep for the mandatory portion and star for the remainder.

nodes.name: rep_min_max.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL repeat-min-max combinator that matches a rule between Min and Max times, using rep for mandatory matches and not_at to enforce the upper bound.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines rep, seq, and not_at to enforce both lower and upper bounds on repetition.

nodes.name: rep_opt.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL optional repeat combinator that matches a rule up to N times, stopping gracefully when the rule no longer matches.

nodes.name: require.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL require combinator that verifies at least N bytes of input are available before proceeding, failing the match if insufficient data exists.

nodes.name: result_on_found.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL enum class defining result_on_found values (true/false) used to control boolean return semantics in character lookup operations.

nodes.name: rules.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL aggregate header that includes all internal rule combinator headers, providing a single include for the complete set of PEG rules.

nodes.name: seq.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL sequence combinator that matches a series of rules in order, implementing the PEG sequential composition operator with variadic templates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses recursive template instantiation with integer_sequence to match rules in sequence, propagating rewind mode through the chain.

nodes.name: skip_control.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL skip_control trait that marks rules for which the Control class should not be invoked during matching, optimizing away unnecessary control dispatch.

nodes.name: sor.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL ordered choice combinator (sum-of-rules) that tries each rule in order and succeeds on the first match, implementing the PEG '/' operator.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses index_sequence and compile-time branching to try rules sequentially with appropriate rewind modes.

nodes.name: star.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL zero-or-more combinator that repeatedly matches a rule until failure, implementing the PEG '*' operator with seq and recursive match.

nodes.name: star_must.hpp
nodes.summary: PEGTL star-must combinator that repeatedly matches a rule but raises a parse error if the first sub-rule of each iteration fails after partial progress.

nodes.name: AllocTest_main.cpp
nodes.summary: Main entry point for the allocation profiling test binary, parsing command-line arguments to select publisher or subscriber mode, XML profile file, output file, sample count, and domain ID, then orchestrating the profiling run.

nodes.name: allocation_account
nodes.summary: Records memory allocation events by capturing stack traces and tracking allocation counts per calling function, filtering by the configured allocation service.

nodes.name: deallocation_account
nodes.summary: Records memory deallocation events by capturing stack traces and tracking deallocation counts per calling function, filtering by the configured allocation service.

nodes.name: entities_created
nodes.summary: Initializes memory monitoring via osrf_testing_tools_cpp, sets up unexpected allocation callbacks, enables monitoring in all threads, and begins the EXPECT_NO_MEMORY_OPERATIONS region to detect unexpected allocations after entity creation.

nodes.name: print_results
nodes.summary: Generates XML-formatted profiling result reports, aggregating allocation and deallocation counts across all phases and writing per-function breakdowns to output files.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the publisher by loading XML profiles, creating a DomainParticipant, registering the AllocTestType, creating a topic, publisher, and datawriter with profile-based QoS settings, then signals entity creation completion.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes the multi-phase publisher profiling sequence: waits for discovery, publishes samples with Callgrind instrumentation at each phase boundary (first sample, all samples, undiscovery), and generates profiling reports.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the subscriber by loading XML profiles, creating a DomainParticipant, registering the AllocTestType, creating a topic, subscriber, and datareader with profile-based QoS settings, then signals entity creation completion.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes the multi-phase subscriber profiling sequence: waits for discovery, waits for specified sample counts with Callgrind instrumentation at each phase boundary (first sample, all samples, undiscovery), and generates profiling reports.

nodes.name: deserialize

nodes.name: calculate_serialized_size
nodes.summary: Calculates the CDR-serialized size of an AllocTestType data instance including encapsulation overhead, used by the middleware for buffer allocation.

nodes.name: compute_key
nodes.summary: Computes the key hash for an AllocTestType instance by serializing the key fields and calculating an MD5 digest, used for DDS keyed topic support.

nodes.name: register_AllocTestType_type_identifier
nodes.summary: Registers the AllocTestType's TypeObject and TypeIdentifier with the DDS TypeObject registry, building the complete struct type descriptor with member definitions for dynamic type discovery.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that parses command-line arguments (--publisher/--subscriber, --file, --output, --samples, --domain), creates the appropriate AllocTestPublisher or AllocTestSubscriber instance, initializes it with the XML profile, and runs the profiling sequence.

nodes.name: BasicPayloadPool.hpp
nodes.summary: Factory class that creates the appropriate IPayloadPool implementation based on memory management policy (preallocated, dynamic, etc.), using a strategy pattern with template specializations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses template specialization via #include of implementation headers within a detail namespace to create memory-policy-specific IPayloadPool implementations.

nodes.name: Base.hpp
nodes.summary: Base implementation of IPayloadPool providing default get_payload and release_payload methods, plus the primary template Impl<policy> that inherits from BaseImpl.

nodes.name: Dynamic.hpp
nodes.summary: Template specialization of Impl for DYNAMIC_RESERVE_MEMORY_MODE that overrides release_payload to free memory immediately via empty().

nodes.name: DynamicReusable.hpp
nodes.summary: Template specialization of Impl for DYNAMIC_REUSABLE_MEMORY_MODE that inherits all behavior from BaseImpl without overrides.

nodes.name: Preallocated.hpp
nodes.summary: Template specialization of Impl for PREALLOCATED_MEMORY_MODE that pre-allocates a fixed-size buffer for payloads.

nodes.name: PreallocatedWithRealloc.hpp
nodes.summary: Template specialization of Impl for PREALLOCATED_WITH_REALLOC_MEMORY_MODE that reserves a minimum buffer size but allows reallocation when larger payloads arrive.

nodes.name: BaseImpl
nodes.summary: Base class implementing IPayloadPool with default get_payload and release_payload methods. Provides the foundation for memory-policy-specific specializations.

nodes.name: Impl<DYNAMIC_RESERVE_MEMORY_MODE>
nodes.summary: Template specialization for dynamic reserve memory mode. Overrides release_payload to immediately free the payload buffer via empty().

nodes.name: Impl<PREALLOCATED_MEMORY_MODE>
nodes.summary: Template specialization for preallocated memory mode. Stores a fixed payload_size_ and always reserves that amount regardless of requested size.

nodes.name: Impl<PREALLOCATED_WITH_REALLOC_MEMORY_MODE>
nodes.summary: Template specialization for preallocated-with-realloc memory mode. Maintains a minimum payload size and uses std::max to allow reallocation when larger payloads are needed.

nodes.name: TopicPayloadPool.cpp
nodes.summary: Implementation of the TopicPayloadPool base class providing core payload allocation, release, pool sizing, and a factory method that creates the appropriate pool subclass based on memory policy.

nodes.name: TopicPayloadPool.hpp
nodes.summary: Header defining the TopicPayloadPool abstract base class and its inner PayloadNode class. Implements the ITopicPayloadPool interface with reference-counted payload memory management using calloc/realloc.

nodes.name: Dynamic.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines DynamicTopicPayloadPool, a TopicPayloadPool subclass for DYNAMIC_RESERVE_MEMORY_MODE that allocates payloads on demand and frees them immediately when their reference count drops to zero.

nodes.name: DynamicReusable.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines DynamicReusableTopicPayloadPool, a minimal TopicPayloadPool subclass for DYNAMIC_REUSABLE_MEMORY_MODE that delegates to do_get_payload with resizeable=true and inherits default release behavior to keep freed payloads in the pool.

nodes.name: Preallocated.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PreallocatedTopicPayloadPool, a TopicPayloadPool subclass for PREALLOCATED_MEMORY_MODE that pre-allocates a fixed number of payloads at a fixed size and does not resize them.

nodes.name: PreallocatedWithRealloc.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines PreallocatedReallocTopicPayloadPool, a TopicPayloadPool subclass for PREALLOCATED_WITH_REALLOC_MEMORY_MODE that pre-allocates payloads but allows realloc to accommodate larger sizes.

nodes.name: TopicPayloadPool
nodes.summary: Abstract base class implementing ITopicPayloadPool. Manages a pool of PayloadNode objects with reference counting, free-list recycling, and configurable maximum pool sizing. Provides the factory method get() to create policy-specific subclasses.

nodes.name: PayloadNode
nodes.summary: Inner class of TopicPayloadPool that manages a single payload buffer. Uses a NodeInfo header embedded before the data pointer to store atomic reference count, data size, and pool index. Supports resize via realloc and atomic reference/dereference operations.

nodes.name: DynamicTopicPayloadPool
nodes.summary: Pool subclass for DYNAMIC_RESERVE_MEMORY_MODE. Allocates payloads on demand and deletes them when the last reference is released, keeping no free list. Overrides release_payload to remove and delete the PayloadNode entirely.

nodes.name: DynamicReusableTopicPayloadPool
nodes.summary: Pool subclass for DYNAMIC_REUSABLE_MEMORY_MODE. Allocates payloads dynamically but returns them to the free list on release (inherits base release_payload), enabling reuse without deallocation.

nodes.name: PreallocatedTopicPayloadPool
nodes.summary: Pool subclass for PREALLOCATED_MEMORY_MODE. Pre-allocates a fixed number of payloads at a fixed size on reserve_history. Does not resize payloads; always returns a fixed-size buffer.

nodes.name: PreallocatedReallocTopicPayloadPool
nodes.summary: Pool subclass for PREALLOCATED_WITH_REALLOC_MEMORY_MODE. Pre-allocates payloads at a minimum size but allows realloc to grow them when a larger payload is requested.

nodes.name: do_get_payload
nodes.summary: Core payload acquisition logic. Tries to reuse a payload from the free list, allocating a new one if empty. Optionally resizes the payload if the requested size exceeds the current buffer. Sets up reference counting and populates the output SerializedPayload_t.

nodes.name: get_payload
nodes.summary: Copy-based payload acquisition. If the source payload is owned by this pool, increments its reference count and shares the buffer. Otherwise, allocates a new payload and copies the data into it.

nodes.name: release_payload
nodes.summary: Decrements the payload's reference count. When it reaches zero, returns the PayloadNode to the free list for reuse. Clears the output payload fields.

nodes.name: reserve_history
nodes.summary: Notifies the pool that a new history is being reserved. Delegates to update_maximum_size to increase the pool's capacity limit.

nodes.name: release_history
nodes.summary: Notifies the pool that a history is being released. Updates the maximum size and shrinks the pool to the new limit.

nodes.name: update_maximum_size
nodes.summary: Adjusts the pool's maximum size when a history is reserved or released. Tracks infinite-size histories separately from finite ones, setting max_pool_size_ to UINT32_MAX when any infinite history is active.

nodes.name: reserve
nodes.summary: Ensures the pool has at least min_num_payloads allocated by calling do_allocate for each missing slot and adding them to the free list.

nodes.name: shrink
nodes.summary: Reduces pool size to at most max_num_payloads by removing entries from the free list and deleting them. Uses swap-and-pop to remove from the all_payloads_ vector efficiently.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Static factory method that creates the appropriate TopicPayloadPool subclass (Preallocated, PreallocatedRealloc, Dynamic, or DynamicReusable) based on the memory policy in the provided BasicPoolConfig.

nodes.name: pthread_mutex_timedlock

nodes.name: DDSReturnCode.idl
nodes.summary: Defines the DDS standard return code constants (RETCODE_OK through RETCODE_ILLEGAL_OPERATION) as an IDL module, extracted from the OMG DDS DCPS specification.
nodes.languageNotes: IDL module defining a typedef and 13 constant return code values following the OMG DDS specification.

nodes.name: DDSSecurityReturnCode.idl
nodes.summary: Extends the DDS return codes with a security-specific return code (RETCODE_NOT_ALLOWED_BY_SECURITY = 1000) for the DDS Security plugin SPI.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes DDSReturnCode.idl via #include directive and adds a single security-specific constant to the DDS module.

nodes.name: dds-xtypes_typeobject.idl
nodes.summary: Comprehensive IDL schema defining the DDS XTypes type system, including TypeIdentifier, TypeObject, and complete/minimal representations for all DDS type kinds (struct, union, enum, bitmask, bitset, alias, annotation, sequence, array, map). This is the core type representation schema for the DDS XTypes specification.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive IDL file (1077 lines) defining ~80+ types covering the full DDS XTypes type object model. Uses IDL annotations (@extensibility, @nested, @bit_bound, @optional, @external, @default, @position, @id) extensively. Follows the COMPLETE/MINIMAL duality pattern where each type has both a full and a hash-based minimal representation.

nodes.name: TypeLookupTypes.idl
nodes.summary: Defines the IDL types for the DDS TypeLookup builtin service, including request/response structures for querying TypeObjects and type dependencies. Used by the TypeLookup service endpoint in Fast DDS discovery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses IDL union types with hash-based discriminators (TypeLookup_getTypes_HashId, TypeLookup_getDependencies_HashId) for RPC-style service dispatch. References rpc::RequestHeader and rpc::ReplyHeader from rpc_types.idl.

nodes.name: rpc_types.idl
nodes.summary: Defines foundational RPC infrastructure types including GUID, SequenceNumber, SampleIdentity, and request/reply headers used by DDS builtin services such as TypeLookup.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines RTPS-compatible types (GuidPrefix_t, EntityId_t, GUID_t, SequenceNumber_t) from the RTPS v1.2 specification, plus RPC request/reply header types. Contains commented-out preprocessor guards (#ifdef BASIC, #ifdef REDEFINE_DDS_TYPES) indicating selective compilation support.

nodes.name: BoostAtExitRegistry.hpp
nodes.summary: Singleton registry that simulates std::atexit behavior for Boost interprocess singleton destructors, executing registered functions in reverse order on destruction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom deleter with shared_ptr to make the destructor private while still allowing singleton lifetime management.

nodes.name: BoostAtExitRegistry
nodes.summary: Singleton struct that holds function pointers to Boost interprocess destructor callbacks, executing them in reverse registration order when destroyed.

nodes.name: RobustInterprocessCondition.hpp
nodes.summary: Interprocess condition variable implementation using a pool of interprocess semaphores organized in linked lists, providing robust wait/notify semantics across processes with support for both boost ptime and std::chrono time points.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fixed pool of 512 semaphore nodes managed by two linked lists (listening and free) to implement condition variable semantics over Boost.Interprocess primitives. Supports both boost::posix_time and std::chrono time points.

nodes.name: RobustInterprocessCondition
nodes.summary: Interprocess condition variable that manages a pool of 512 semaphores organized in listening and free linked lists, providing notify_one, notify_all, wait, and timed_wait operations across process boundaries.

nodes.name: SharedMemSegment.hpp
nodes.summary: Core shared memory abstraction layer providing SharedSegmentBase (abstract base with named mutex management) and SharedSegment<T,U> template class for creating, opening, and managing Boost.Interprocess shared memory and memory-mapped file segments.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines SharedMemSegment and SharedFileSegment type aliases using Boost.Interprocess template specializations with rbtree_best_fit allocator and offset_ptr for 32/64-bit portability.

nodes.name: SharedSegmentBase
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for shared memory segments, providing static methods for creating and locking named interprocess mutexes with timeout-based deadlock recovery, and defining the inner Id class for segment identification.

nodes.name: SharedSegment
nodes.summary: Template class deriving from SharedSegmentBase that wraps Boost.Interprocess managed shared memory or mapped file objects, providing create/open/remove operations and allocation overhead estimation.

nodes.name: SharedMemUUID.hpp
nodes.summary: UUID generation and representation utilities for shared memory segment identification, providing a singleton UUIDGen using Mersenne Twister seeded from process ID and high-resolution clock, and a templated UUID<SIZE> class with hashing and comparison support.
nodes.languageNotes: UUIDGen uses std::seed_seq with process ID and timestamp to seed std::mt19937, with a mutex-guarded busy-wait to ensure unique timestamps. UUID<SIZE> specializes std::hash for UUID<8>.

nodes.name: UUIDGen
nodes.summary: Thread-safe singleton UUID generator that produces unique byte sequences using a Mersenne Twister engine seeded from the process ID and high-resolution clock timestamp.

nodes.name: TimedEventImpl.h
nodes.summary: Header defining the TimedEventImpl class, which encapsulates a single timer with an atomic three-state machine (INACTIVE, READY, WAITING), a callback, and trigger/interval management for the RTPS event-service subsystem.

nodes.name: TimedEventImpl
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a single timer with an atomic state machine (INACTIVE/READY/WAITING). Manages expiration interval, next trigger time, and callback invocation. Used by ResourceEvent to schedule and fire timed events.

nodes.name: event_compare
nodes.summary: Static comparator that orders two TimedEventImpl pointers by their next_trigger_time, used for maintaining the sorted active_timers vector.

nodes.name: ResourceEvent
nodes.summary: Default constructor that allocates the internal thread object for the event service.

nodes.name: ~ResourceEvent
nodes.summary: Destructor that asserts all timers have been unregistered and stops the event-service thread.

nodes.name: stop_thread
nodes.summary: Signals the event-service thread to stop by setting the stop flag, notifying the condition variable, and joining the thread.

nodes.name: register_timer
nodes.summary: Increments the timer count under lock and notifies the event-service thread that a new timer has been registered.

nodes.name: unregister_timer
nodes.summary: Removes a TimedEventImpl from both pending and active timer collections, handling the case where the calling thread is the service thread itself, and notifies the service thread if changes were made.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Registers a timer in the pending list (if not already present) under lock and notifies the event-service thread.

nodes.name: notify (timeout overload)
nodes.summary: Overloaded notify that optionally uses try_lock_until for strict real-time support, registering the timer and notifying the service thread.

nodes.name: register_timer_nts
nodes.summary: No-thread-safe helper that adds a timer to the pending_timers_ vector if not already present.

nodes.name: event_service
nodes.summary: Main event-service loop that updates current time, processes timer actions, and sleeps until the next timer trigger or a notification, coordinating with other threads via condition variables.

nodes.name: sort_timers
nodes.summary: Sorts the active_timers_ vector by next trigger time using the event_compare comparator.

nodes.name: update_current_time
nodes.summary: Updates the cached current_time_ to the current steady_clock time point.

nodes.name: do_timer_actions
nodes.summary: Core timer processing: moves pending timers into the sorted active list, triggers expired timers, handles timer state transitions, and cleans up cancelled timers.

nodes.name: init_thread
nodes.summary: Initializes and starts the event-service thread with the given thread configuration, resetting state and launching event_service as the thread function.

nodes.name: TimedEvent
nodes.summary: Constructor that creates a TimedEventImpl with the given callback and interval (converted to microseconds), and registers it with the ResourceEvent service.

nodes.name: ~TimedEvent
nodes.summary: Destructor that unregisters the timer from the ResourceEvent service and deletes the TimedEventImpl.

nodes.name: cancel_timer
nodes.summary: Cancels the timer by transitioning its state to INACTIVE and notifying the event service if the state change succeeded.

nodes.name: restart_timer
nodes.summary: Restarts the timer by transitioning its state to READY and notifying the event service.

nodes.name: restart_timer (timeout overload)
nodes.summary: Restarts the timer with a timeout for the notification lock, supporting strict real-time configurations.

nodes.name: recreate_timer
nodes.summary: Recreates the timer by unregistering, cancelling, and re-registering it with the ResourceEvent service.

nodes.name: TimedEventImpl
nodes.summary: Constructor that initializes the timer's interval, trigger time, callback, and sets the initial state to INACTIVE.

nodes.name: go_ready
nodes.summary: Atomically transitions the timer state from INACTIVE to READY using compare_exchange_strong, returning true on success.

nodes.name: go_cancel
nodes.summary: Atomically transitions the timer state to INACTIVE using exchange, returning true if the previous state was not already INACTIVE.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates the timer state: transitions READY to WAITING and sets next trigger time, or marks cancelled timers with a cancel_time.

nodes.name: trigger
nodes.summary: Triggers the timer callback if in WAITING state, atomically transitions to INACTIVE, and optionally reschedules if the callback returns true.

nodes.name: update_interval
nodes.summary: Updates the timer's expiration interval by converting a Duration_t to microseconds.

nodes.name: update_interval_millisec
nodes.summary: Updates the timer's expiration interval from a millisecond value.

nodes.name: Cases_declarations.json

nodes.name: Cases_key.json

nodes.name: Cases_maps.json

nodes.name: Cases_mutable.json
nodes.summary: Test case configuration for DDS XTypes mutable (fully extensible) type interoperability tests. Defines publisher/subscriber test scenarios for mutable struct types covering aliases, arrays, enums, maps, sequences, strings, and nested structures with mutable extensibility kind.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: CMake configuration for Fast DDS example integration tests. Sets up Docker-based testing infrastructure with platform-specific variables (Linux/Windows), configures compose files with placeholder substitution, and registers pytest-based test cases for each example.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CMake configure_file() to substitute @PLACEHOLDER@ variables in compose YAML and Python test files. Platform-conditional logic handles Linux (bash, host networking) vs Windows (PowerShell, custom Docker image) differences.

nodes.name: benchmark.compose.yml

nodes.name: configuration.compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose template for the Fast DDS configuration example test. Defines publisher and subscriber services demonstrating DDS configuration options.

nodes.name: content_filter.compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose template for the Fast DDS content-filtered topic example test. Defines publisher and subscriber services demonstrating content filtering on DDS topics.

nodes.name: custom_payload_pool.compose.yml

nodes.name: delivery_mechanisms.compose.yml

nodes.name: delivery_mechanisms_isolated.compose.yml

nodes.languageNotes: Uses Docker bridge networking with static IP addresses (113.1.1.x) to isolate containers while still allowing shared memory transport discovery.

nodes.name: discovery_server.compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose template for the Fast DDS discovery server example test. Defines publisher, subscriber, and two discovery server services demonstrating centralized participant discovery via a discovery server topology.

nodes.name: flow_control.compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose template for the Fast DDS flow control example test. Defines publisher and subscriber services demonstrating DDS flow controller configuration for bandwidth management.

nodes.name: hello_world.compose.yml

nodes.name: request_reply.compose.yml

nodes.name: request_reply_isolated.compose.yml

nodes.name: rtps.compose.yml

nodes.name: xtypes_complete.compose.yml

nodes.name: xtypes_minimal.compose.yml

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: CMake build configuration for the Fast DDS latency performance test. Defines the LatencyTest executable from four C++ source files and registers a comprehensive matrix of CTest test cases covering intraprocess/interprocess modes, UDP/SHM transports, reliable/best-effort reliability, data sharing, data loans, and security.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the Fast DDS latency performance test suite. Describes the latency measurement methodology (round-trip sample timing), compilation via CMake, CLI usage of the LatencyTest utility in publisher/subscriber/both roles, and a Python launcher script for automated test execution.

nodes.name: payloads_demands.csv
nodes.summary: CSV data file defining the payload sizes (16 and 16384 bytes) used as demands for latency performance tests.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_best_effort_shm_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using shared memory (SHM) transport with BEST_EFFORT reliability and VOLATILE durability on domain 231.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines publisher and subscriber participants with SHM transport descriptors, BEST_EFFORT data writer/reader QoS, and data_sharing OFF.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_best_effort_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using TCPv4 transport with BEST_EFFORT reliability, TCP_NODELAY enabled, and subscriber connecting to publisher on port 7400.
nodes.languageNotes: Configures TCPv4 transport with keep_alive settings, CRC disabled, TCP_NODELAY enabled. Subscriber uses initialPeersList to connect to publisher at 127.0.0.1:7400.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_best_effort_udp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using UDPv4 transport with BEST_EFFORT reliability and localhost-only interface whitelist.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines UDPv4 transport with interfaceWhiteList restricted to 127.0.0.1. Both publisher and subscriber share the same transport descriptor.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_reliable_shm_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using shared memory (SHM) transport with RELIABLE reliability and VOLATILE durability on domain 231.
nodes.languageNotes: Same structure as best_effort SHM profile but uses RELIABLE reliability kind for guaranteed delivery semantics.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_reliable_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using TCPv4 transport with RELIABLE reliability, TCP_NODELAY enabled, and subscriber connecting to publisher on port 7400.
nodes.languageNotes: Same TCP transport settings as best_effort variant but with RELIABLE reliability kind. Subscriber uses initialPeersList for connection.

nodes.name: latency_interprocess_reliable_udp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess latency testing using UDPv4 transport with RELIABLE reliability and localhost-only interface whitelist.
nodes.languageNotes: Same UDP transport settings as best_effort variant but with RELIABLE reliability kind.

nodes.name: latency_intraprocess_best_effort_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for intraprocess latency testing with BEST_EFFORT reliability, discovery filtering to same-process-only participants, and FULL intraprocess delivery enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ignoreParticipantFlags FILTER_DIFFERENT_PROCESS | FILTER_DIFFERENT_HOST for same-process discovery. Enables library_settings intraprocess_delivery FULL for zero-copy in-process communication.

nodes.name: latency_intraprocess_reliable_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for intraprocess latency testing with RELIABLE reliability, discovery filtering to same-process-only participants, and FULL intraprocess delivery enabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Same intraprocess discovery settings as best_effort variant but with RELIABLE reliability kind for guaranteed delivery.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: CMake build configuration for the Fast DDS throughput performance test. Compiles the ThroughputTest executable from C++ sources, defines test matrices for intraprocess/interprocess, reliable/best-effort, shared memory/UDP transport modes, and configures test variants including data sharing, data loans, and security.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the Fast DDS throughput performance testing tool. Explains the testing methodology (sending bursts of samples with configurable recovery times), compilation with CMake PERFORMANCE_TESTS option, command-line usage for publisher/subscriber/both roles, batch testing via CSV files, and the Python launcher script.

nodes.name: payloads_demands.csv
nodes.summary: CSV data file defining test payload demands for throughput testing. Contains two configurations: 16-byte and 32-byte sample sizes, each with a burst demand of 100 samples.

nodes.name: recoveries.csv
nodes.summary: CSV data file defining recovery times (break intervals between sample bursts) for throughput testing. Contains a single configuration with 0ms recovery time.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_best_effort_shm_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using shared memory (SHM) transport with best-effort reliability. Defines transport descriptors for SHM and UDPv4, publisher/subscriber participant profiles on domain 120, and data writer/reader QoS settings with BEST_EFFORT reliability and VOLATILE durability.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses eProsima DDS XML profile format with SHM transport combined with UDPv4 for discovery, intraprocess delivery disabled.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_best_effort_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using TCPv4 transport with best-effort reliability. Defines TCP transport descriptors with keep-alive settings and TCP_NODELAY enabled, publisher listening on port 7400, subscriber connecting via initialPeersList, and data writer/reader QoS with BEST_EFFORT reliability.
nodes.languageNotes: TCP transport configuration uses explicit port 7400 for publisher listening and subscriber initial peer discovery with TCP_NODELAY for low latency.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_best_effort_udp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using UDPv4 transport with best-effort reliability. Defines UDP transport with localhost-only interface whitelist, publisher/subscriber participant profiles on domain 222, and data writer/reader QoS with BEST_EFFORT reliability and VOLATILE durability.
nodes.languageNotes: UDP transport restricted to localhost (127.0.0.1) via interfaceWhiteList for isolated testing.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_reliable_shm_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using shared memory (SHM) transport with RELIABLE reliability. Defines SHM and UDPv4 transport descriptors, publisher/subscriber participant profiles on domain 222, and data writer/reader QoS with RELIABLE reliability for guaranteed delivery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SHM transport for data and UDPv4 for discovery; RELIABLE QoS ensures all samples are delivered.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_reliable_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using TCPv4 transport with RELIABLE reliability. Defines TCP transport descriptors with keep-alive and TCP_NODELAY settings, publisher listening on port 7400, subscriber connecting via initialPeersList, and data writer/reader QoS with RELIABLE reliability.
nodes.languageNotes: TCP transport with explicit port configuration and TCP_NODELAY; RELIABLE QoS for guaranteed message delivery over TCP.

nodes.name: throughput_interprocess_reliable_udp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for interprocess throughput testing using UDPv4 transport with RELIABLE reliability. Defines UDP transport with localhost-only interface whitelist, publisher/subscriber participant profiles on domain 222, and data writer/reader QoS with RELIABLE reliability for guaranteed delivery.
nodes.languageNotes: UDP transport restricted to localhost; RELIABLE QoS adds acknowledgment-based delivery on top of UDP.

nodes.name: throughput_intraprocess_best_effort_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for intraprocess throughput testing with best-effort reliability. Configures discovery to filter different processes and hosts, enables USER_DATA_ONLY intraprocess delivery, and sets data writer/reader QoS with BEST_EFFORT reliability for single-process performance benchmarking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses library_settings intraprocess_delivery=USER_DATA_ONLY and ignoreParticipantFlags to isolate to same-process communication.

nodes.name: throughput_intraprocess_reliable_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for intraprocess throughput testing with RELIABLE reliability. Configures discovery to filter different processes and hosts, enables USER_DATA_ONLY intraprocess delivery, and sets data writer/reader QoS with RELIABLE reliability for guaranteed single-process performance benchmarking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses library_settings intraprocess_delivery=USER_DATA_ONLY with RELIABLE QoS for guaranteed intraprocess message delivery.

nodes.name: video_interprocess_best_effort_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for video interprocess performance testing with BEST_EFFORT reliability over default UDP transport. Defines publisher and subscriber participant profiles on domain 229 with volatile durability, asynchronous publish mode, and KEEP_ALL history.

nodes.name: video_interprocess_best_effort_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for video interprocess performance testing with BEST_EFFORT reliability over TCPv4 transport. Defines custom TCP transport descriptors with CRC disabled, TCP_NODELAY enabled, keep-alive at 1s/10s, publisher listening on port 7400, and subscriber connecting via initialPeersList to 127.0.0.1.

nodes.name: video_interprocess_reliable_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for video interprocess performance testing with RELIABLE reliability over default UDP transport. Defines publisher and subscriber participant profiles on domain 229 with volatile durability, asynchronous publish mode, and KEEP_ALL history.

nodes.name: video_interprocess_reliable_tcp_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration for video interprocess performance testing with RELIABLE reliability over TCPv4 transport. Defines custom TCP transport descriptors with CRC disabled, TCP_NODELAY enabled, keep-alive at 1s/10s, publisher listening on port 7400, and subscriber connecting via initialPeersList to 127.0.0.1.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Test build configuration for the Fast DDS discovery server tool. Defines 15+ Python-based system tests and a C++ Google Test executable (CliDiscoveryManagerTests) that validates the CLI discovery manager. Handles Windows PowerShell launcher integration and security certificate file copying.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses configure_file() to copy test XML profiles and security certificates into the build directory. On Windows, wraps Python test execution in a PowerShell script to work around CTest signal handling limitations.

nodes.name: launcher.ps1
nodes.summary: Windows PowerShell helper script that launches Python test scripts as a child process, working around CTest signal handling issues on Windows. Throws on non-zero exit codes to propagate test failures.

nodes.name: test_wrong_xml_discovery_server_profile.xml
nodes.summary: Intentionally misconfigured DDS XML profile defining SIMPLE and CLIENT discovery participants with non-standard locator addresses and ports, used for negative testing of discovery server XML parsing.

nodes.name: test_xml_discovery_server_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration defining four participant profiles for discovery server testing: a default SERVER with dual locators, a second SERVER, a BACKUP participant, and a no-prefix SERVER variant.

nodes.name: test_xml_secure_discovery_server_profile.xml
nodes.summary: Secure DDS XML profile configuration defining two SERVER participant profiles with full DDS Security plugin chain: PKI-DH authentication, Access-Permissions authorization, and AES-GCM-GMAC encryption. One profile includes a prefix, the other does not.
nodes.languageNotes: Configures three DDS Security plugins: dds.sec.auth (PKI-DH), dds.sec.access (Access-Permissions), and dds.sec.crypto (AES-GCM-GMAC). References PEM certificates and S/MIME governance/permissions files.

nodes.name: test_xml_for_string_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration file defining participant, data writer, and data reader profiles with string-based profile names (suffix '_string') for unit testing string-based profile lookup. Contains library settings with full intraprocess delivery, two participant profiles with RTPS discovery and allocation settings, two data writer profiles with QoS policies (durability, liveliness, reliability, partition), and two data reader profiles with history and resource limits.

nodes.name: test_xml_profile.xml
nodes.summary: DDS XML profile configuration file defining the full set of DDS entity profiles for unit testing: two participant profiles with RTPS settings, two data writer profiles, two data reader profiles, a topic profile, a replier profile, and a requester profile. This is the primary test profile XML covering all major DDS entity types with various QoS configurations including durability, liveliness, reliability, partition, and history settings.

nodes.name: test_xml_service_easy_mode.xml
nodes.summary: Minimal DDS XML profile configuration defining a single data writer profile named 'service' with basic QoS settings (reliability max blocking time of 5 seconds, volatile durability). Used for testing DDS service easy mode functionality.

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Filled_EPROSIMA_1.json

Enumerations and bitmasks are represented as detailed objects with name/value fields. Covers complex_array, complex_map, complex_sequence, index, and inner_struct sections.

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Filled_EPROSIMA_3.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture JSON containing a third set of populated sample data for a comprehensive DDS XTypes type using the EPROSIMA serialization format. Same structure as variant 1, providing additional test coverage for the serializer.

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Filled_OMG_1.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture JSON containing populated sample data for a comprehensive DDS XTypes type using the OMG serialization format. nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Filled_OMG_2.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture JSON containing a second set of populated sample data for a comprehensive DDS XTypes type using the OMG serialization format. Structurally identical to OMG variant 1, providing additional test coverage.

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Filled_OMG_3.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture JSON containing a third set of populated sample data for a comprehensive DDS XTypes type using the OMG serialization format. Same structure as OMG variant 1, providing additional test coverage for the serializer.

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Unfilled_EPROSIMA.json

nodes.name: ComprehensiveType_Unfilled_OMG.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture JSON containing zero/empty default values for a comprehensive DDS XTypes type using the OMG serialization format. Used to verify that the serializer correctly handles unfilled or default-initialized data structures.

nodes.name: 20187_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file with heavily corrupted binary content in a publisher profile's historyMemoryPolicy element, variant 2, testing parser crash resilience against binary data.

nodes.name: 20608_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file containing a thread_settings element with an extremely large port value (88888888888888888884) overflowing integer bounds to test parser numeric validation.

nodes.name: 20610_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file containing a builtinTransports max_msg_size with the same overflow value (88888888888888888884) to test numeric overflow handling in transport configuration parsing.

nodes.name: 20732_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file containing a builtinTransports max_msg_size with an invalid string value '1i' instead of a numeric value to test parser type validation for numeric fields.

nodes.name: 21153_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file containing a typedef with extremely large negative stringMaxLength value to test parser handling of integer underflow in string length constraints.

nodes.name: 21154_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file with binary-corrupted content containing a typedef with embedded garbage bytes in sequenceMaxLength to test parser error handling on mixed binary/text input.

nodes.name: 21181_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file containing a bitset definition with binary-corrupted name attribute and invalid numeric strings to test parser handling of corrupted type names.

nodes.name: 21223_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Large XML regression test file (378 lines) with heavily corrupted binary content mixed with DDS profile and type fragments, testing parser resilience against large malformed inputs with embedded struct definitions, publisher profiles, and type system elements.

nodes.name: 21334_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: XML regression test file with binary-corrupted content containing fragments of DDS profiles, types, and struct definitions with embedded garbage bytes to test parser error recovery.

nodes.name: 21856_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture used as a regression input for the XML parser (issue #21856). Contains malformed binary data embedded within XML-like tags to test parser robustness against fuzzing-style inputs.

nodes.name: 22054_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture for the XML parser (issue #22054). Contains a malformed bitset definition with invalid baseType to test parser error handling on type declarations.

nodes.name: 22101_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture for the XML parser (issue #22101). Contains malformed topic and typedef declarations with garbled attribute values including negative sequenceMaxLength values to test boundary condition handling.

nodes.name: 22535_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture for the XML parser (issue #22535). Contains malformed bitmask and typedef declarations with binary garbage data to test parser crash resilience.

nodes.name: 22843_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture for the XML parser (issue #22843). Contains extensive malformed type definitions with garbled binary data and invalid attribute values designed to stress the parser.

nodes.name: 22844_profile_bin.xml
nodes.summary: Corrupted binary XML test fixture for the XML parser (issue #22844). Contains extensive malformed type definitions with binary garbage, negative mapMaxLength values, and malformed subscriber declarations to test parser robustness.

nodes.name: simple_participant_profiles_nok.xml
nodes.summary: Intentionally invalid DDS XML participant profiles used as a negative test case for the XML parser. Contains two participant profiles with duplicate elements: one with two domainId tags and another with two rtps tags, testing that the parser correctly rejects malformed profiles.

nodes.name: simple_participant_profiles_ok.xml
nodes.summary: Valid DDS XML participant profiles used as a positive test case for the XML parser. Contains five participant profiles exercising various configurations: empty participant, rtps-only participants (with different closing tag styles), domainId-only participant, and a complete participant with both domainId and rtps.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Build configuration for the fastdds Python CLI tool. Copies Python scripts and subdirectories (discovery, shm, xml_ci) to the build directory during EPROSIMA_BUILD, and installs Python files plus platform-specific launcher scripts to the bin directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CMake configure_file and file(COPY ...) for build-time file staging; platform-conditional install for Windows (.bat) vs POSIX (shell) launchers.

nodes.name: fastdds.bat
nodes.summary: Windows batch launcher for the fastdds Python CLI tool. Validates Python availability and invokes fastdds.py with optional PYTHON_VERSION environment variable support.

nodes.name: ros-discovery.bat
nodes.summary: Windows batch launcher for the fastdds ROS discovery subcommand. Validates Python availability and invokes fastdds.py with the 'discovery' argument.

nodes.name: check_shared_mutex_priority.cpp
nodes.summary: Compile-time test program that detects whether the platform's shared_mutex favors readers or writers by attempting to acquire a shared lock while an exclusive lock is pending.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that tests shared_mutex priority behavior by acquiring a shared lock, spawning an exclusive-locking thread, then checking if a second shared lock succeeds (reader-preferring) or fails (writer-preferring).
