nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: CMake build configuration for the fuzz testing subdirectory. Adds subdirectories for XMLProfiles and processCDRMsg fuzz test targets.

nodes.name: config.hpp.in
nodes.summary: CMake template for the Fast DDS configuration header. Defines version macros, C++ standard support flags, security/SQLite3/TLS feature flags, log macros, deprecation utilities, and compile-time feature detection.

nodes.name: doxygen_modules.hpp
nodes.summary: Doxygen module definitions for organizing Fast DDS API documentation. Defines documentation groups for RTPS, DDS public API, QoS, transport, discovery, security, and other subsystems.

nodes.name: BuiltinTopicKey.hpp
nodes.summary: DDS-layer type alias for BuiltinTopicKey_t, re-exporting the RTPS-layer BuiltinTopicKey_t into the eprosima::fastdds::dds namespace.

nodes.name: ParticipantBuiltinTopicData.hpp
nodes.summary: DDS-layer type alias for ParticipantBuiltinTopicData, re-exporting the RTPS-layer struct into the eprosima::fastdds::dds namespace.

nodes.name: PublicationBuiltinTopicData.hpp
nodes.summary: DDS-layer type alias for PublicationBuiltinTopicData, re-exporting the RTPS-layer struct into the eprosima::fastdds::dds namespace.

nodes.name: SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData.hpp
nodes.summary: DDS-layer type alias for SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData, re-exporting the RTPS-layer struct into the eprosima::fastdds::dds namespace.

nodes.name: TopicBuiltinTopicData.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the TopicBuiltinTopicData struct containing topic discovery metadata including key, name, type name, and associated QoS policies (durability, deadline, liveliness, reliability, history, resource limits, ownership).

nodes.name: Condition.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the Condition base class, the root of the DDS condition hierarchy that can be attached to a WaitSet. Provides get_trigger_value() and a notifier for WaitSet integration.

nodes.name: GuardCondition.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the GuardCondition class, a Condition whose trigger_value is manually controlled by the application to wake up a WaitSet. Inherits from Condition and uses an atomic bool for thread-safe trigger management.

nodes.name: StatusCondition.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the StatusCondition class, a Condition associated with each DDS Entity that monitors communication status changes. Uses the pimpl pattern via StatusConditionImpl for implementation hiding.

nodes.name: WaitSet.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the WaitSet class that allows applications to block until one or more attached Conditions have a trigger_value of TRUE or until a timeout expires. Supports attach, detach, wait, and get_conditions operations.

nodes.name: Entity.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the Entity abstract base class for all DDS objects supporting QoS policies, listeners, and status conditions. Also defines DomainEntity as a subclass to differentiate DomainParticipants from other entities.

nodes.name: LoanableArray.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the LoanableArray template struct, a type-safe stack-allocated collection that can be loaned to a LoanableCollection. Provides a buffer_for_loans() method for zero-copy data transfer.

nodes.name: LoanableCollection.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the LoanableCollection abstract base class for collections of opaque pointers that support external buffer loans. Manages buffer ownership, length, and maximum capacity with loan/unloan semantics for zero-copy data distribution.

nodes.name: LoanableSequence.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the LoanableSequence template class, a type-safe ordered collection corresponding to IDL sequence<T>. Inherits from LoanableTypedCollection and provides copy semantics, resize, release, and the FASTDDS_SEQUENCE macro for type aliasing.

nodes.name: LoanableTypedCollection.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the LoanableTypedCollection template class, a type-safe wrapper around LoanableCollection that provides operator[] for indexed access to elements with bounds checking.

nodes.name: ParameterTypes.hpp
nodes.summary: Comprehensive header defining RTPS parameter types for DDS discovery and configuration. Contains the ParameterId_t enum with all RTPS parameter IDs, and numerous parameter struct types (ParameterGuid_t, ParameterIP4Address_t, ParameterPropertyList_t, ParameterSampleIdentity_t, etc.) used for wire protocol serialization.

nodes.name: ReaderDataLifecycleQosPolicy.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines ReaderDataLifecycleQosPolicy controlling DataReader behavior regarding instance lifecycle. Configures autopurge delays for no-writer and disposed samples using Duration_t values.

nodes.name: ReaderResourceLimitsQos.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines ReaderResourceLimitsQos policy for configuring DataReader resource limits including matched publisher allocation, sample info allocation, outstanding reads allocation, and maximum samples per read.

nodes.name: RTPSReliableReaderQos.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines RTPSReliableReaderQos policy combining ReaderTimes and DisablePositiveACKsQosPolicy for configuring reliable reader behavior at the RTPS transport layer.

nodes.name: RTPSReliableWriterQos.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines RTPSReliableWriterQos policy combining WriterTimes, DisablePositiveACKsQosPolicy, and heartbeat piggyback control for configuring reliable writer behavior at the RTPS transport layer.

nodes.name: WriterDataLifecycleQosPolicy.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines WriterDataLifecycleQosPolicy controlling whether a DataWriter automatically disposes instances when they are unregistered. Configured via the autodispose_unregistered_instances boolean flag.

nodes.name: BaseStatus.hpp
nodes.summary: Defines the BaseStatus struct with total_count and total_count_change fields, serving as the base for DDS status types. Also provides type aliases for SampleLostStatus, LivelinessLostStatus, and InconsistentTopicStatus.

nodes.name: TopicDescription.hpp
nodes.summary: Abstract base class representing a topic description that ties publications and subscriptions to a single data type in the DDS domain.

nodes.name: TopicDescription
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for topic descriptions, providing methods to retrieve the associated DomainParticipant, topic name, and type name.

nodes.name: TopicListener.hpp
nodes.summary: Listener class for topic events, providing callback for inconsistent topic detection in DDS.

nodes.name: TopicListener
nodes.summary: Listener class that users can extend to implement callbacks for topic events, particularly for inconsistent topic detection.

nodes.name: TypeSupport.hpp
nodes.summary: TypeSupport class that inherits from shared_ptr<TopicDataType>, providing serialization, deserialization, and key computation for DDS data types.

nodes.name: TypeSupport
nodes.summary: Class that manages TopicDataType instances via shared_ptr, providing methods for type registration, serialization, deserialization, and key computation.

nodes.name: common.hpp
nodes.summary: Common definitions for XTypes modules including enums for extensibility, try-construct actions, placement kinds, and constants for primitive type and annotation names.

nodes.name: AnnotationDescriptor.hpp
nodes.summary: Descriptor class for annotations in the dynamic type system, providing methods to access and modify annotation type references and key-value parameters.

nodes.name: AnnotationDescriptor
nodes.summary: Abstract descriptor class for annotations, providing access to the annotation type, key-value parameter storage, copy/comparison operations, and consistency checking.

nodes.name: dynamic_language_binding.idl
nodes.summary: IDL definitions extracted from the DDS-XTypes v1.3 standard, defining TypeKind constants, enums, and sequence type aliases for the dynamic type system.

nodes.name: DynamicData.hpp
nodes.summary: Dynamic data representation class for runtime-typed DDS data, providing methods for member access, collection manipulation, and value get/set operations across all DDS type kinds.

nodes.name: DynamicData
nodes.summary: Abstract class representing runtime-typed DDS data, providing pure virtual methods for member access by name/index/ID, collection size queries, and value get/set for all DDS type kinds.

nodes.name: DynamicDataFactory.hpp
nodes.summary: Singleton factory class for creating and deleting DynamicData instances associated with DynamicType references.

nodes.name: DynamicDataFactory
nodes.summary: Singleton factory for creating DynamicData instances from DynamicType references, with methods for creation and deletion of data objects.

nodes.name: DynamicPubSubType.hpp
nodes.summary: TopicDataType implementation for dynamic types, enabling serialization, deserialization, and key computation for runtime-typed DDS data.

nodes.name: DynamicPubSubType
nodes.summary: TopicDataType implementation for dynamic types, providing create_data, delete_data, serialize, deserialize, compute_key, and calculate_serialized_size operations.

nodes.name: DynamicType.hpp
nodes.summary: Abstract class representing a dynamic type definition in the DDS XTypes system, providing methods to query type kind, members, annotations, and verbatim text.

nodes.name: DynamicType
nodes.summary: Abstract class for dynamic type definitions, providing methods to retrieve type descriptor, name, kind, members by name/index/ID, annotations, and verbatim text.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeBuilder.hpp
nodes.summary: Builder class for constructing DynamicType instances, providing methods to add members, set properties, and build the final type definition.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeBuilder
nodes.summary: Abstract builder class for constructing DynamicType instances, with methods for querying type properties, adding/modifying members, and building the final type.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeBuilderFactory.hpp
nodes.summary: Singleton factory for creating DynamicTypeBuilder instances, providing methods to create builders from type descriptors, TypeObjects, and primitive types.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeBuilderFactory
nodes.summary: Singleton factory for creating DynamicTypeBuilder instances from TypeDescriptors, DynamicTypes, TypeObjects, and for creating string/wstring/collection/structure/union/enum/alias/sequence/array/map types.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeMember.hpp
nodes.summary: Class representing a member of a dynamic type, which may be a struct member, enum constant, or other type substructure.

nodes.name: DynamicTypeMember
nodes.summary: Abstract class representing a member of a dynamic type, providing methods to retrieve descriptor, annotations, verbatim text, ID, and name.

nodes.name: MemberDescriptor.hpp
nodes.summary: Descriptor class for type members in the dynamic type system, providing access to member name, ID, type reference, default value, label, and other properties.

nodes.name: MemberDescriptor
nodes.summary: Abstract descriptor class for type members, providing access to name, ID, type reference, default value, labels, index, and properties like try-construct, optional, must-understand, key, and external.

nodes.name: TypeDescriptor.hpp
nodes.summary: Descriptor class for dynamic types, providing access to type kind, name, base type, discriminator type, bound, element type, key element type, extensibility, and nested flag.

nodes.name: TypeDescriptor
nodes.summary: Abstract descriptor class for dynamic types, providing access to kind, name, base type, discriminator type, bound, element/key element types, extensibility kind, and is_nested property.

nodes.name: VerbatimTextDescriptor.hpp
nodes.summary: Descriptor class for verbatim text annotations, specifying placement location and literal text to be inserted in generated output.

nodes.name: VerbatimTextDescriptor
nodes.summary: Abstract descriptor class for verbatim text, providing access to placement location and literal text content for code generation.

nodes.name: Exception.hpp
nodes.summary: Exception classes for the DDS XTypes module, including the base Exception class and InvalidArgumentError for invalid argument handling.

nodes.name: Exception
nodes.summary: Base exception class for DDS XTypes exceptions, providing a virtual what() method for retrieving exception information.

nodes.name: InvalidArgumentError
nodes.summary: Exception class for invalid argument errors, inheriting from both Exception and std::invalid_argument.

nodes.name: ITypeObjectRegistry.hpp
nodes.summary: Interface for the TypeObject/TypeIdentifier registry, providing methods to register and query TypeObjects, TypeIdentifiers, and TypeInformation.

nodes.name: ITypeObjectRegistry
nodes.summary: Abstract interface for the TypeObject registry, providing methods to register local/remote TypeObjects, TypeIdentifiers, and query TypeObjects, TypeIdentifiers, and TypeInformation by type name or identifier.

nodes.name: TypeObject.hpp
nodes.summary: Auto-generated header including the DDS XTypes TypeObject definitions, CDR auxiliary functions, and PubSub types from fastddsgen.

nodes.name: TypeObjectUtils.hpp
nodes.summary: Utility class with static methods for building TypeObject instances, including methods for constructing flags, hash IDs, and validating type consistency.

nodes.name: TypeObjectUtils
nodes.summary: Utility class with static methods for building TypeObject instances, including constructors for hash IDs, flags, members, collections, structures, unions, enumerations, aliases, and consistency validation functions.

nodes.name: utils.hpp
nodes.summary: Utility functions for serializing DynamicType to IDL format and DynamicData to JSON format.

nodes.name: fastdds_auto_link.hpp
nodes.summary: MSVC auto-linking configuration that uses #pragma comment(lib) to automatically link the Fast DDS library with correct version and debug suffixes.

nodes.name: fastdds_dll.hpp
nodes.summary: DLL export/import macro definitions for Fast DDS, handling dynamic/static linking configuration and the FASTDDS_EXPORTED_API macro for Windows DLL boundaries.

nodes.name: LibrarySettings.hpp
nodes.summary: Library settings class defining Fast DDS runtime behavior, including the intraprocess delivery mode configuration.

nodes.name: LibrarySettings
nodes.summary: Class for configuring Fast DDS library behavior, with an intraprocess_delivery setting that controls whether data is delivered within the process via INTRAPROCESS_OFF, INTRAPROCESS_USER_DATA_ONLY, or INTRAPROCESS_FULL modes.

nodes.name: BuiltinTransports.hpp

nodes.name: ParticipantBuiltinTopicData.hpp

nodes.name: ParticipantBuiltinTopicData

nodes.name: PublicationBuiltinTopicData.hpp

tour.title: DDS Public API: Domain & Participants
tour.description: The DDS standard defines a domain-centric publish-subscribe model. DomainParticipantFactory creates DomainParticipant instances that act as entry points for all DDS operations. These headers define the public C++ API that applications use to join a domain, create publishers and subscribers, and manage topics. This is the top-level abstraction layer built on top of the RTPS wire protocol.
tour.languageLesson: The Factory pattern is used here to hide the complexity of participant creation. DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance() returns a singleton, while create_participant() encapsulates all the RTPS configuration needed to join a DDS domain.

tour.title: DDS Public API: Publishers, Subscribers & Topics
tour.description: Building on the DomainParticipant from Step 1, these headers define the Publisher, Subscriber, and Topic abstractions. Publishers create DataWriters to send data, Subscribers create DataReaders to receive it, and Topics define the data type and name that connect them. Together these form the core DDS publish-subscribe API surface.

tour.title: RTPS Wire Protocol: Core Types & Locators
tour.description: The RTPS (Real-Time Publish-Subscribe) protocol is the wire protocol underlying DDS. These headers define the fundamental RTPS types: GUIDs that uniquely identify participants and endpoints, Locators that specify network addresses, and basic enumerations for the protocol. Understanding these types is essential before diving into the RTPS implementation.

tour.title: DomainParticipant Implementation
tour.description: The DomainParticipantImpl class bridges the DDS API from Steps 1-2 with the RTPS layer from Step 3. It manages the lifecycle of publishers, subscribers, topics, and content filters, delegating to RTPSParticipantImpl for wire-protocol operations. This is the central orchestrator of the library, connecting the public API facade to the internal RTPS engine.
tour.languageLesson: The PImpl (Pointer to Implementation) idiom is used extensively in Fast DDS. DomainParticipantImpl hides the internal implementation details from the public header, allowing the API to remain stable while internals change. This also reduces compile-time dependencies.

tour.title: Discovery: Finding Participants & Endpoints
tour.description: DDS discovery allows participants to find each other automatically without manual configuration. The PDP (Participant Discovery Protocol) handles participant discovery, while EDP (Endpoint Discovery Protocol) handles writer/reader matching. PDPServer implements the discovery server pattern, centralizing discovery information for improved scalability in large deployments.
tour.languageLesson: The discovery server pattern uses a client-server model where clients register with a central server instead of using multicast. This reduces network traffic and works across subnets that don't support multicast. PDPServerListener handles incoming registration messages from clients.

tour.title: Transport Layer: TCP Implementation
tour.description: Fast DDS supports multiple transport protocols: UDP, TCP, and shared memory. The TCP transport implementation handles connection management, TLS security, and the RTCP control protocol. TCPTransportInterface is the abstract base, with Basic and Secure variants for plain and TLS connections respectively. This layer provides reliable, connection-oriented communication when needed.

tour.title: Security: Cryptographic Protection
tour.description: Fast DDS implements the DDS Security specification, providing authentication, access control, and cryptographic protection for data in transit. The AES-GCM-GMAC plugin handles encryption and authentication of RTPS messages using AES in Galois/Counter Mode. This ensures confidentiality and integrity of DDS communications even over untrusted networks.
tour.languageLesson: AES-GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) provides both encryption and authentication in a single pass, making it more efficient than separate encryption + HMAC. GMAC is the authentication-only variant used when confidentiality is not needed but message integrity is required.

tour.title: Dynamic Types & XTypes
tour.description: The XTypes (Extensible Types) system allows defining data types at runtime rather than compile time. DynamicTypeBuilder creates types programmatically, DynamicTypeImpl stores type metadata, and DynamicDataImpl holds instances of dynamic types. This enables applications to work with data types discovered through the network without prior knowledge of their structure.

tour.title: Content Filtering: SQL-Based Data Selection
tour.description: DDS content filtering allows subscribers to specify which data they want to receive using SQL-like filter expressions. The DDSFilterFactory parses filter expressions using PEG grammar rules, builds a filter tree, and evaluates predicates against incoming data. This enables efficient data filtering at the subscriber side without requiring publishers to filter data.
tour.languageLesson: PEG (Parsing Expression Grammar) is used here via the taocpp-pegtl library to define the SQL filter syntax. Unlike regular expressions, PEG parsers handle recursive grammars and provide better error messages. The DDSFilterGrammar.hpp defines the complete SQL-like filter grammar.

tour.title: XML Configuration: Runtime Profile System
tour.description: Fast DDS supports XML-based configuration through the XMLDynamicParser. Users can define participant, publisher, subscriber, and topic profiles in XML files, which are loaded at runtime. This separates configuration from code and enables different deployment configurations without recompilation. The parser handles both static and dynamic type definitions from XML.

tour.title: Hello World Example: Complete DDS Application
tour.description: The hello_world example demonstrates a complete DDS application with publisher and subscriber. It shows how to define a data type using IDL, create a DomainParticipant, register the type, create a topic, and set up publishers/subscribers. The main.cpp parses CLI options to run as publisher or subscriber, providing a practical starting point for new developers.
tour.languageLesson: The listener pattern is used for asynchronous event notification in DDS. ListenerSubscriberApp shows how to implement a SubscriberListener that gets called when new data arrives. Alternatively, WaitsetSubscriberApp demonstrates the wait-set pattern for synchronous data reception.

tour.title: Build System: CMake Configuration
tour.description: The CMake build system manages compilation of the Fast DDS library and its dependencies. check_configuration.cmake validates compiler settings and feature flags, while eprosima_libraries.cmake handles third-party dependency integration. The build system supports multiple platforms including Linux, Windows, macOS, and QNX cross-compilation.
tour.languageLesson: CMake toolchain files (like qnx.nto.toolchain.cmake) define cross-compilation settings including the compiler, sysroot, and target platform flags. This allows building Fast DDS for embedded systems like QNX from a host machine.

tour.title: Fast DDS CLI Tools
tour.description: The tools directory contains command-line utilities for Fast DDS. fastdds.py provides a Python-based CLI for discovery server management, configuration, and ROS integration. These tools simplify common tasks like starting a discovery server, checking network configuration, and debugging DDS communication issues.

tour.title: CI/CD: GitHub Actions Workflows
tour.description: The CI/CD pipeline uses GitHub Actions to automate testing across multiple configurations. Workflows handle building on different platforms, running unit and integration tests, code coverage analysis, and security scanning. The configuration files in .github/workflows/config/ define build matrices and test parameters for comprehensive validation.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use YAML to define jobs that run on GitHub-hosted runners. The .meta files here contain build configuration parameters that are injected into the workflow matrix, enabling testing across multiple compilers, OS versions, and build options.
